title: Modern modal CV
brief: Modernize the existing CV using midu.dev as reference; open each complete section in a modal. Retain cyan/navy and full width.

artboards.title: Editorial Orbit
artboards.tradeoff: Large editorial hero and visual bento cards; strongest identity, fewer cards above the fold.

artboards.title: Focus Canvas
artboards.tradeoff: Split hero and paired modules; calmer reading, less visual density.

artboards.title: Studio Stack
artboards.tradeoff: Compact studio dashboard with four-column catalog; fastest scanning, less personal emphasis.
